verdict.rationale: BVNK documents programmatic customer creation for embedded partners (a 'create embedded partner customer' guide, wallets created per customer ID, 'CUSTOMER ENABLED' wallets) and third-party payouts. None of the evidence describes KYC/KYB verification endpoints, document or identity submission, or a status that clears a counterparty before funds move. Missing for 10: explicit KYC/KYB endpoints or flows, recipient/beneficiary verification, onboarding status/approval gating before payments, webhook events for verification outcomes, independent corroboration.
